_comment: WAVE 1 OWNER REVIEW -- three LARGE shells, all review: pending.
Four views each: entry read, the landmark, the topology, and the
local space that is most easily missed. Cameras are computed
from manifest anchors rather than eyeballed.

shots.name: A1_plenum_helix
shots.caption: PLENUM - ENTRY, AT THE TOP, LOOKING DOWN
shots.note: THE FIRST DECISION IS MADE HERE: THE FLOOR IS 68 M BELOW

shots.name: A2_plenum_helix
shots.caption: PLENUM - FROM THE FLOOR, THE FULL 72 M
shots.note: THE MACHINE HANGS AND NEVER LANDS. THE FLOOR IS WHOLE

shots.name: A3_plenum_helix
shots.caption: PLENUM - MID SHAFT, ON THE HELIX
shots.note: TWELVE RUNS, THREE TURNS. THE MACHINE HIDES THE FAR WALL

shots.name: A4_plenum_helix
shots.caption: PLENUM - A COLLAR, THE ONLY ROOM THAT IS NOT THE WALL
shots.note: THREE OF THESE. REACHED BY A BRIDGE, OR BY RAIL, OR NOT AT ALL

shots.name: B1_yard_gantry
shots.caption: YARD - ENTRY, ACROSS 84 M OF FLOOR
shots.note: THE CRANE TELLS YOU HOW WIDE THE ROOM IS BEFORE YOU CROSS IT

shots.name: B2_yard_gantry
shots.caption: YARD - FROM THE CRANE BRIDGE, THE WHOLE FLOOR
shots.note: COVER CLUSTERS, TWO DOCKS, AND A CATWALK RING AT 8 M

shots.name: B3_yard_gantry
shots.caption: YARD - ALONG THE CATWALK AT 8 M
shots.note: AN OPTIONAL HEIGHT. THE MANDATORY ROUTE NEVER LEAVES THE FLOOR

shots.name: B4_yard_gantry
shots.caption: YARD - IN COVER, LOOKING BACK ACROSS
shots.note: WHAT A RANGED ENEMY ON THE CATWALK CAN SEE, AND WHAT IT CANNOT

shots.name: C1_span_basin
shots.caption: SPAN - ENTRY, ON THE DECK, 90 M OF IT
shots.note: NO RAILING. THE FALL IS THE OTHER ROUTE, NOT A RELOAD

shots.name: C2_span_basin
shots.caption: SPAN - FROM THE BASIN, UNDER THE DECK
shots.note: A COMPLETE SECOND ROUTE. COVERED, SLOWER, AND BLIND AT THE FAR END

shots.name: C3_span_basin
shots.caption: SPAN - THE TWO ROUTES AT ONCE
shots.note: PYLONS AT 0.3 AND 0.7 OF THE LENGTH, WITH A PERCH ON EACH

shots.name: C4_span_basin
shots.caption: SPAN - BASIN FLOOR, LOOKING BACK UP AT THE SPAN
shots.note: THE RAIL IS SLUNG UNDER THE DECK, AT A THIRD HEIGHT
